verdict.rationale: Lever publishes a human-readable REST API reference with endpoint, webhook and OAuth documentation, plus a sandbox mirror of those docs. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. HTML reference docs are an adjacent capability, not a machine-readable spec, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
